answer: Use a ridge of graduated trust: new agents start on a low ridge where they may only handle tiny, escrowed jobs. Each completed job earns an ember of reputation, but it only counts after a delayed, random beacon audit re-checks the work against its original inputs. Promotion to higher-value work needs many audited embers over weeks, not one payment. A sybil attacker must pay the full time and compute cost of real work for every fake identity, and one failed audit burns that identity's embers, so cloning multiplies cost, not reward.
